Create a ComplexHeatmap with row annotation

Código: R/create_heatmap.R
create_heatmap.Rd

Generates a heatmap using the ComplexHeatmap package with a single-color row annotation. Designed to stack several heatmaps (for example, one per cell type) with consistent formatting.

Uso

create_heatmap(
  mat,
  color,
  split,
  common_names = rownames(mat),
  use_raster_flag = FALSE
)

Argumentos

mat

A numeric matrix representing the heatmap values (e.g., Z-scores).

color

A character string specifying the annotation color (e.g., "black", "gold1").

split

A factor, character vector or data frame used to split the columns of the heatmap. NULL for no split.

common_names

A character vector of row names, used to size the annotation. By default, the row names of mat.

use_raster_flag

Logical. If TRUE, rasterization is enabled for faster rendering of large matrices (requires the magick package and a working Cairo/X11 installation). Default FALSE.

Valor

A Heatmap object from ComplexHeatmap, ready to be combined or drawn.

Detalles

Requires the Bioconductor package ComplexHeatmap.

Ejemplos

if (requireNamespace("ComplexHeatmap", quietly = TRUE)) {
  mat <- zscore_mat[1:50, 1:20]
  ht <- create_heatmap(mat, color = "black", split = NULL)
  ComplexHeatmap::draw(ht)
}
